title: dwork workspace configuration
description: Configuration version 1 for existing Compose containers, host commands, and browser URLs. Run dwork validate for filesystem and Compose checks.

version.description: Configuration format version. Write the integer 1.

name.description: Optional default registration name. Explicit register NAME and existing saved names take precedence. Does not change the Compose project identity.

confirm.description: Ask before applying a single-workspace activation plan. Registration, group, task, browser, and shutdown confirmations are separate.

locked.description: Protect this workspace's containers and tracked commands from switches and dwork down. Activation is still allowed.

compose.description: Select existing Compose containers. Omit to use normal Compose discovery with Compose enabled.

enabled.description: Enable Compose management. Set false for host-only workspaces and omit files, services, and terminal health prerequisites.

files.description: Nonempty list of Compose file paths relative to dwork.yml. CLI file flags and COMPOSE_FILE take precedence.

services.description: Nonempty list of Compose service names to manage. Omit to manage all existing target-project containers.

terminals.description: Tracked host commands to launch after outgoing workspace shutdown, container startup, and all terminal health gates. Switching away or dwork down stops eligible commands. Each activation launches them again.

browsers.description: Application URLs to open in order after terminal tasks are dispatched. Each entry has separate confirmation and HTTP readiness settings.

httpUrl.description: Absolute HTTP/HTTPS URL without credentials, backslashes, whitespace, or non-ASCII characters. Percent-encode spaces and non-ASCII characters. dwork validate also checks the host and port.

command.description: Executable and argument strings, quoted by dwork. Use a script for pipelines or compound shell commands. Quote numeric or boolean-looking arguments in YAML.

title.description: Nonempty terminal title. Defaults to dwork: <project>.

cwd.description: Existing working directory relative to dwork.yml. dwork validate checks that it exists.

window.description: Open a new window, request an existing-window tab, or run detached with output discarded. Apple Terminal and xterm support new windows only for visible tasks.

launcher.description: Terminal adapter. auto uses DWORK_TERMINAL or platform/desktop selection. Ignored for window: none.

confirm.description: Ask before launching this command. Explicit false skips only this task's prompt.

wait_for.description: Existing Compose services that must be running and healthy before any terminal opens.

healthy.description: Nonempty list of Compose service names with existing containers and health checks. Must also be in compose.services when that selection is set.

timeout.description: Health wait timeout in seconds, greater than zero and at most 3600.

browser.description: default, a Linux executable, a macOS application name/path, or a Windows .exe name/absolute path on WSL. One application without command-line flags.

confirm.description: Ask before waiting for and opening this URL. Explicit false skips only this browser entry's prompt.

wait_for.description: HTTP readiness settings. Omit to poll the page URL for 60 seconds; set false to open immediately without an HTTP request.

url.description: Separate HTTP/HTTPS health endpoint to probe. Defaults to the browser entry's URL.

timeout.description: HTTP retry deadline in seconds, greater than zero and at most 3600.
